verdict.rationale: Greptile is a codebase-aware PR reviewer that claims v5 catches more bugs with fewer false positives (docs-26). It filters toward high-signal feedback through noise control and strictness settings (docs-32, docs-20), and TREX runs the branch to find runtime-only bugs (docs-19). One hands-on user at an employer says it 'more often than not catches real issues,' though it is sometimes overzealous (comm-8). Missing for 10: no evidence specifically showing logic-error, race-condition or edge-case detection; no independent accuracy benchmarks; independent corroboration is limited to a single anecdote.
